Title: Admin UI cannot upload a lender logo, so no lender can be added from the UI
Where (endpoint / screen): UI /lenders?create=1 -> browser PUT to gus-dev-bucket S3 presigned URL
Steps to reproduce: 1. Open Lenders > Add lender. 2. Choose any PNG as logo. 3. Fill all required fields. 4. Click Create lender.
Expected: Logo uploads, lender is created.
Actual: Console: CORS policy blocks the S3 preflight (no Access-Control-Allow-Origin for https://gusdev.softwareco.com). Toast 'Failed to fetch', then POST /lenders returns 422 'A logo is required'. A server-side PUT to the same URL returns 200.
Automated test: Manual (browser console); lenders were seeded via API
Suggested fix: S3 bucket CORS: allow PUT/OPTIONS from the admin origin(s).

Title: Add product form silently drops invalid eligibility criteria and still submits
Steps to reproduce: 1. Fill the form validly. 2. Set Minimum income = -1 (or min age 18.5, DTI 'abc', surplus -1). 3. Click Create product. 4. Inspect the request.
Expected: Field error shown, nothing submitted (the API rejects these values with 422).
Actual: No error. The invalid field is omitted from the payload (e.g. {"criteria":{"minAgeYears":21}}) and the form submits: product saved with fewer or no eligibility rules.
Suggested fix: Product form criteria parsing: treat a non-empty value that fails parsing as a validation error.

Title: Lender product count includes deactivated products
Where (endpoint / screen): GET /lenders (productCount); UI /lenders Products column; UI /lenders/:id 'Loan products (N)'
Steps to reproduce: 1. Pick a lender with several products. 2. Deactivate two (Stop offering > Deactivate). 3. Open /lenders and the lender page.
Expected: Count shows live products (e.g. 4) or '4 active of 6'; inactive products are marked on the lender page.
Actual: Shows 6 with 2 deactivated (NAB test). Lender page lists the deactivated products with no 'Inactive' text. Loan products list and dashboard are correct (19 total / 16 active / 3 inactive). Live check 2026-10-06: Bank of Queensland productCount=2, active=1. UPDATE 2026-10-06: FIXED IN THE UI. Lender list and lender page now read '7 active of 8' / 'Loan products (7 active of 8)' and mark inactive products. The API field productCount is unchanged (still the total, 8).
Status: Fixed in UI (API field still total)
Suggested fix: Lender list aggregation: filter isActive:true, or return productCount and activeProductCount.

Title: API accepts creating and editing a product under a deactivated lender
Steps to reproduce: 1. Use a lender with isActive=false (was ANZ). 2. POST /products with that lenderId. 3. PUT an existing product with {"lenderId": <inactive lender>}.
Expected: 4xx rejection: only active lenders allowed (product owner decision 2026-10-05).
Actual: Create returned 201; edit returned 200. UI lender dropdown is fixed (lists only active lenders). ANZ was reactivated on dev on 2026-10-06, so re-checking needs a deactivated lender.
Last verified: 2026-10-06 (create and edit confirmed 201/200 before ANZ was reactivated; core run now skips it)
Automated test: test_inactive_lender_rejected (strict xfail; skips while no lender is inactive)
Suggested fix: Product create/update service: check lender.isActive next to the existing lender-exists check.

Title: Writes limited to 100/hour and rejected requests count against the limit

Automated test: Rate-limit probe; WRITE_BUDGET guard in the suites
Suggested fix: Admin API rate-limit middleware: count only successful mutations or raise the ceiling.

Title: Products list cannot be sorted: sortBy / sortOrder are ignored (and invalid values are accepted)
Steps to reproduce: 1. GET /products?limit=100&sortBy=interestRateBps&sortOrder=asc and again with desc (also name, minAmountCents, createdAt). 2. Compare the order. 3. GET with sortBy=bogus.
Expected: Rows ordered by the chosen field; asc and desc are reverse of each other; invalid values return 422 (the Users list does).
Actual: With 65 products: every sortBy and both sortOrder values return the identical default order (newest first); ascending is not ascending. sortBy=bogus returns 200. The UI table has no sortable headers, so an admin cannot sort 65 products by rate, name or amount.
Suggested fix: Products list query: implement sortBy/sortOrder with an allowed-field enum, then add sortable headers to the UI table.

Title: Term chips are single-select: only one term can be saved, and editing one chip collapses a multi-term product to one term
Steps to reproduce: 1. Add form: click 12 mo, 24 mo, 36 mo, then add custom 18. 2. Submit and read the saved product. 3. Edit form on 'Fixed Rate Personal Loan' (6 terms, all shown selected): click '24 mo' and save.
Expected: Several terms can be selected (the control is labelled Term (months) with chips and an Add button; the API, list and seeded products carry many terms). Editing one chip must keep the others.
Actual: Add: only the last click is kept; saved termMonths = [18]. Edit: one click sends termMonths [24] for a product with 12/24/36/48/60/84. Product list and detail then show a single term. Silent data loss on edit.
Suggested fix: Term chip group: make it a multi-select (toggle each chip) and keep unchanged terms in the update payload.

Title: Phone numbers are not validated per country (India, Australia and others): invalid numbers are accepted by the form and the API
Where (endpoint / screen): UI /lenders?create=1 (contact phone) and POST /lenders; existing customer records
Steps to reproduce: 1. Add lender, choose India (+91) as the country. 2. Enter 123456789 (9 digits), 1234567890 (starts with 1), 98765432101 (11 digits) or 5876543210 (starts with 5). 3. Submit. 4. Repeat via POST /lenders with contactPhone +91123456789 etc.
Expected: Indian mobile = 10 digits starting 6-9; Australian = 9 digits starting 2, 3, 4, 7 or 8; other countries by their own rules. Invalid numbers are blocked with an error in the form and rejected with 422 by the API.
Actual: UI sends any digits for every country (India, Australia, US, UK tested; only letters/empty are blocked). API 201 for +91123456789, +911234567890, +9198765432101, +915876543210 and +91000000000; it only rejects a missing '+' and very short numbers (+6112345). Stored data already has invalid numbers: customers +911234567891, +91468456256, +611234567890 (3 of 15) and lender Preventive Health Review +6161459966825.
Suggested fix: Validate contactPhone with a phone library (libphonenumber) in the lender form and the API schema; fix the existing records. Apply the same to the customer registration flow.
